description: SPA support for the AWS deployment (plan D6/D7, item 2): a runtime config file (web/config.js locally, generated by Terraform on AWS), a Cognito hosted-UI login with OAuth code + PKCE that sends the ID token as the Authorization header, and polling after the async 202 upload. Local behavior (no auth, sync 201 upload, same origin or http://localhost:8787 for file://) must not change. Depends on FEAT-005 (202 {documentId,status:'RECEIVED'} contract and /health auth field).
steps: Create web/config.js with only: a header comment (generated on AWS by infra/terraform/envs/dev/templates/config.js.tftpl; this local copy disables auth) and `window.AGILIA_CONFIG = { authMode: "none", apiBaseUrl: null };`.

web/index.html: add `` immediately before ``. In the CSP meta, change connect-src to `'self' http://localhost:8787 http://127.0.0.1:8787 https://*.amazoncognito.com` and update the HTML comment above it. In the header's right-hand chip group add ``, reusing the existing Tailwind chip classes. Keep #auth-banner; app.js rewrites its text in cognito mode.
web/app.js: at the top read `var CFG = window.AGILIA_CONFIG || { authMode: 'none', apiBaseUrl: null };`. API_BASE = typeof CFG.apiBaseUrl === 'string' ? CFG.apiBaseUrl : (existing file:// logic).

web/app.js auth module (only when CFG.authMode === 'cognito'): sessionStorage keys 'agilia.idToken', 'agilia.pkceVerifier', 'agilia.oauthState'. login(): random verifier (crypto.getRandomValues, base64url, 64 chars) and state, then challenge = base64url(SHA-256(verifier)) via crypto.subtle.digest. Redirect to `${CFG.cognitoDomain}/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=${CFG.clientId}&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(CFG.redirectUri)}&scope=openid+email+profile&code_challenge_method=S256&code_challenge=...&state=...`. On init, if the URL has ?code=: check state, POST `${CFG.cognitoDomain}/oauth2/token` (Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded: grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, code, redirect_uri, code_verifier), store id_token, then history.replaceState to strip the query. Errors go to showError in Spanish. A token whose JWT exp (base64url payload decode) is in the past counts as absent. logout(): clear storage and redirect to `${CFG.cognitoDomain}/logout?client_id=...&logout_uri=${encodeURIComponent(CFG.redirectUri)}`. The UI shows #auth-user (email claim) + #btn-logout when signed in and #btn-login otherwise. The banner says '🔐 Autenticación con Amazon Cognito' when signed in and '🔒 Inicie sesión para usar AgilIA' otherwise. doUpload/decisions/draft require a token: without one, call showError('Inicie sesión para continuar.').

web/app.js api(): when a token exists add header `Authorization: <idToken>`. On HTTP 401/403 in cognito mode, clear the token, refresh the auth UI, and throw Error('Sesión expirada o no autorizada. Inicie sesión de nuevo.'). Also handle API Gateway's {message:'Unauthorized'} body shape when building the error message.

web/app.js doUpload(): after the POST, if `record.status === 'RECEIVED'` (AWS async path), poll every 3000 ms with `api('/documents/' + id)` until status is 'DRAFTED' (then refreshRecord + loadDraft as today) or 'ERROR' (showError('El procesamiento en AWS falló. Revise los registros de CloudWatch.')). Give up after 100 attempts with a timeout error. While polling, set #resumen-analisis to 'Procesando en AWS… (puede tardar hasta 1–2 minutos)'. The 201 local path keeps the exact current flow.
src/server/app.ts: add `app.get('/config.js', () => serveWebFile('config.js'));` next to the other static routes.

tests/server/server.integration.test.ts: add a test 'GET /config.js serves the local runtime config' that checks status 200, content-type contains 'javascript', and the body contains 'authMode'. Add one asserting that GET /health still returns auth 'none' locally.
acceptance_criteria: `bunx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and `bun test` reports 0 failures (new config.js and health tests pass).
web/app.js parses: `bun -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('web/app.js','utf8'))"` (cwd worktree) exits 0. Same for web/config.js.
In authMode 'none' no login UI is shown and every request goes out without an Authorization header (code inspection plus the unchanged local flow).
The Cognito flow uses PKCE S256 and sessionStorage only. It never handles a client secret or a password.
verification: cwd worktree: bun -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('web/app.js','utf8')); new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('web/config.js','utf8')); console.log('spa js ok')"
findings:
DONE. Verification (cwd worktree): bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0; bun test 71 pass / 0 fail across 9 files (69 before + 2 new in tests/server/server.integration.test.ts: 'GET /config.js serves the local runtime config', "GET /health still reports auth 'none' locally"); bun -e parse check prints 'spa js ok'. Extra (not committed): a throwaway bun script ran web/app.js with stubbed window/document/fetch. Local mode: upload 201 -> GET /documents/d1 -> GET draft, no Authorization header, auth UI and banner untouched. Cognito mode: banner/login shown without a token; upload without a token -> 'Inicie sesión para continuar.'; the authorize URL is correct (S256, 64-char verifier and state); the callback POSTs the token form and stores id_token; email is shown; the 202 RECEIVED upload polls and then loads the draft, with Authorization on every API call; a state mismatch is rejected and no token is stored.

AGILIA_CONFIG KEYS READ BY web/app.js (FEAT-007 config.js.tftpl must emit exactly these; window.AGILIA_CONFIG = {...}): authMode ('cognito' enables auth; anything else or a missing config = no auth), apiBaseUrl (string is used verbatim as the API prefix; emit "" on AWS = same origin behind CloudFront; null/non-string = local fallback same origin or http://localhost:8787 for file://), cognitoDomain (FULL origin with scheme and no trailing slash, e.g. https://<prefix>.auth.us-east-2.amazoncognito.com; app.js appends /oauth2/authorize, /oauth2/token, /logout), clientId (SPA app client id, no secret), redirectUri (exact callback = logout URL registered on the client, i.e. https://<cloudfront_domain>/ with trailing slash; used for authorize, token exchange and logout_uri). region and userPoolId are NOT read by app.js (harmless to emit, plan D6 shape keeps them).

OAUTH: authorize `${cognitoDomain}/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=..&redirect_uri=..&scope=openid+email+profile&code_challenge_method=S256&code_challenge=..&state=..`; token POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, code, redirect_uri, code_verifier (no secret); logout `${cognitoDomain}/logout?client_id=..&logout_uri=..`. Cognito client therefore needs: allowed_oauth_flows=[code], allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client=true, allowed_oauth_scopes=[openid,email,profile], supported_identity_providers=[COGNITO], callback_urls and logout_urls containing redirectUri, generate_secret=false. sessionStorage keys: agilia.idToken, agilia.pkceVerifier, agilia.oauthState. ID token sent as `Authorization: <id_token>` (no Bearer prefix; REST Cognito authorizer accepts it). Expired token (JWT exp <= now) or an undecodable token counts as absent and is dropped. 401/403 in cognito mode -> token cleared, UI refreshed, error 'Sesión expirada o no autorizada. Inicie sesión de nuevo.'. Error messages also read API Gateway's {message} body shape.

ELEMENT IDS (web/index.html): new auth-user (span, email claim), btn-login, btn-logout (all start hidden); auth-chip-none (id ADDED to the existing '🔓 Sin autenticación' header chip so cognito mode hides it; not in the plan, but it avoids a misleading chip while signed in); existing auth-banner (text rewritten in cognito mode to '🔐 Autenticación con Amazon Cognito' / '🔒 Inicie sesión para usar AgilIA'); resumen-analisis shows 'Procesando en AWS… (puede tardar hasta 1–2 minutos)' while polling. index.html loads <script src="config.js"> right before app.js; CSP connect-src = 'self' http://localhost:8787 http://127.0.0.1:8787 https://*.amazoncognito.com. src/server/app.ts serves GET /config.js from web/ (text/javascript).

POLLING: triggered only when the upload response has status === 'RECEIVED'. POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 3000 (wait first, then GET /documents/{id}), POLL_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 100 (~300 s), stop on 'DRAFTED' (then refreshRecord + loadDraft, same as local) or 'ERROR' -> 'El procesamiento en AWS falló. Revise los registros de CloudWatch.' (shown without the 'No se pudo analizar el documento:' prefix); timeout -> 'El procesamiento en AWS no terminó a tiempo (300 s). Recargue más tarde o revise CloudWatch.'. A failed poll request (network/5xx/401) aborts polling with the usual prefixed error. Intermediate statuses (EXTRACTED/ANALYZED/VALIDATED) keep polling. Local 201 path unchanged.

SESSION GUARDS: in cognito mode doUpload, submitDecision, downloadDraft and the 'recargar' draft button need a valid token, otherwise showError('Inicie sesión para continuar.'). In authMode 'none' requireSession() is always true and getIdToken() always null, and api() passes the options object through untouched.

FOR FEAT-007: (1) web/config.js is committed for local use; the frontend module must exclude it from the fileset upload and upload the generated one instead (plan D6). (2) crypto.subtle requires a secure context: works on https CloudFront and on http://localhost; on other http origins login shows 'El navegador no soporta inicio de sesión seguro (se requiere HTTPS).'. (3) CloudFront must forward the query string to S3 for '/?code=...' only so the page loads; app.js reads location.search client-side, so Managed-CachingOptimized is fine (the query is not needed by S3). (4) The Cognito token endpoint is called cross-origin from the SPA; Cognito answers with CORS for the registered callback origin, so no extra config is needed.

GAPS (documented in plan D7): no refresh-token renewal (re-login after ~1 h when the ID token expires); no group-based authorization; the sidebar user card ('Juan S. Poveda', 'Sesión (sin autenticar)') stays static mock content; the amber banner colour is not changed in cognito mode (only its text).

INTEGRATION CHECK (iteration 1, integration fixer; cwd = worktree, no AWS calls, no plan/apply): bun install -> 'Checked 79 installs across 65 packages (no changes)'; bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0; bun test 84 pass / 0 fail across 10 files; bun run build:lambda exit 0 (dist/lambda/api/index.mjs 1585.2 KB, dist/lambda/worker/index.mjs 1347.4 KB); bun run verify:lambda exit 0 ('api: GET /health -> 200 {"status":"ok","auth":"cognito"}', 'worker: handler exportado', 'OK'); terraform 1.17.1 (.tools/terraform/terraform.exe): fmt -check -recursive infra/terraform exit 0; bootstrap and envs/dev init -backend=false -input=false exit 0 + validate 'Success! The configuration is valid.'; git grep -n -i template.yaml outside .kiro/aidlc-docs: only the annotated .agents history and the split-name assertion in tests/infra/terraform-structure.test.ts. SEAM config.js: infra/terraform/envs/dev/templates/config.js.tftpl emits authMode "cognito", apiBaseUrl "", region, userPoolId, clientId, cognitoDomain (module.auth.hosted_ui_domain = https://<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com), redirectUri ("${module.frontend.url}/"). web/app.js reads authMode, apiBaseUrl, cognitoDomain, clientId, redirectUri; all present with the shapes app.js expects. modules/frontend excludes web/config.js from the fileset and uploads the generated one as text/javascript. OK, no change.
